_doc: Owner risk mandate (Section 17 / ADR-0012). OWNER-DECLARED parameters, not model outputs. Changes go through Rule 4 (PROJECT_STATUS Change Log). The engine reading this file is read-only/advice-only (Rule 3).

derivation_assumptions._doc: RESEARCH ASSUMPTIONS with material estimation uncertainty (Rule 17.6) — provenance for ADR-0012's fractional-Kelly derivation, never predictions.

A.label: 杠杆β引擎
A.expectation_label: compensated beta·期望≈2×股权溢价−损耗

betas._doc: Research assumptions (broad-market beta vs TOPIX); _default applies to unmapped symbols.

leverage_factors._doc: Instrument leverage (2x ETFs get 2.0 when added to sleeve_map).

theme_map._doc: Direct symbol→theme tag for sector look-through (Rule 17.7). Broad-index ETFs are NOT tagged here; their sector exposure enters via benchmark_sector_weights so it is not double-counted.

benchmark_sector_weights._doc: RESEARCH ESTIMATE (Rule 17.6), not a prediction: embedded sector weights inside broad-index ETF holdings, used for look-through concentration only. 1568.T (TOPIX 2x) shares TOPIX composition; leverage_factor is applied on top for economic exposure.
benchmark_sector_weights._source: TOPIX sector composition, approximate; refresh via Rule 4 when materially stale

8035.T.thesis: 清算中仓位（非信念持有）。owner 无单票信息优势、承认约 44x 前瞻 PE 的估值风险（街上 12 个月目标 ¥50-66k 均低于现价）；持有理由仅为在预写的双边括号内有序退出，不是押注涨到 8-9 万。expectation≈0·纯方差，退出即终结。
8035.T.invalidation: 双边收盘括号（Rule 17.4.6）：收盘 ≥ ¥74,000（回到 07-15 收盘）或 ≤ ¥64,000（重承保价 71,300 的 -10%）→ 次一交易日下 SBI S 株市价卖单了结。退出条件是收盘价触边，永不因'回到成本 77,600'而改判；触边前不动作。
